lines.text: October is all about me. My birthday month. My snack stand. My halftime.
October is the playoffs, Tiffany. It's about the team.
Respectfully, it's a football game. I am the football.
This year I bought myself a crown. Nobody stopped me.
Nobody could. You were at the register.
Welcome to the snack stand. Tonight, everything is named after me.
Can I just get some nachos?
We have Tiffchos. Same chip. More confidence.
How much?
Four dollars and one compliment.
Your crown is very round.
That's worth three dollars. I'll take it.
Woof.
Gravy stays out of this. He's a professional.
Let's be honest about who the star is. Every Friday, ninety thousand eyes on me.
It's a high school. We have four hundred seats.
And every seat is looking at me.
They're looking at the scoreboard.
I've been kicked more than a vending machine. And still, I show up.
You show up in a bag. I carry you.
That's a limo with a zipper.
Okay. Kickoff in two minutes. Let's go, buddy.
Wait. Tonight I wanted a solo. Just me, in the air, one slow spin.
Kickoff!
I'm back. I have grass in places I don't have.
Welcome to my month, sweetie.
Okay. Halftime. This is my moment.
Slow walk across the fifty yard line. Wind in my hair. Crown on.
The marching band uses the field at halftime.
I told the band. I wrote it on a napkin.
The band doesn't read napkins. The band has sheet music and no mercy.
I've seen it. Tubas don't turn.
Here I go. Main character walk.
Okay, there's a trombone. I'm fine. Oh, that's a lot of drums.
Woof.
They marched right through me. In formation. They spelled the word go.
That's the fight song, Tiffany. They spell it every week.
At least you got a solo. I got a toe.
It's fine. It's still my month. There are eleven days left.
I just need one person to say it out loud.
Tiffany. Look at the scoreboard.
Oh my gosh. It says happy birthday!
Thank you. Thank you, everyone. I didn't think anybody knew.
Keep reading.
Happy birthday, Gravy?
It's Gravy Night. His tenth birthday. Bobbleheads for the first five hundred fans.
We have four hundred seats!
People stood.
Hello, Tiffany.
You talk?
Once a year. On my birthday. In October.
Every year I forget he can do that.
October has always been all about me. Ten years. Ten bobbleheads.
So I wore a crown to your party.
It's a nice crown. I only need tonight. You take the rest of the month.
Really? All eleven days?
Ten. The last one is about candy. Nobody wins that one.
And the playoffs?
No.
Next October, football bobbleheads. It's just a ball. Nailed it.
